command: & { $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; if ($ExecutionContext.SessionState.LanguageMode -ne 'FullLanguage') { throw 'Use your administrator-approved installer: PowerShell language is restricted.' }; if ((Get-ExecutionPolicy -Scope MachinePolicy) -ne 'Undefined' -or (Get-ExecutionPolicy -Scope UserPolicy) -ne 'Undefined' -or (Get-ExecutionPolicy) -eq 'AllSigned') { throw 'Use your administrator-approved installer: a managed or signing policy is configured.' }; $p=Join-Path $env:TEMP ('redagent-'+[guid]::NewGuid()+'.ps1'); try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing https://www.orbitusrobotics.com/r/install.ps1 -OutFile $p -TimeoutSec 120 -ErrorAction Stop; $b=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($p); $h=[Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create(); try { $s=[BitConverter]::ToString($h.ComputeHash($b)).Replace('-','').ToLowerInvariant() } finally { $h.Dispose() }; if ($s -ne 'dedb827133591d81619802bba816a6ae5a50ad90d6fc2a03343a6a2b53b364af') { throw 'Installer SHA-256 mismatch. Download the latest command or Flipper script from the website.' }; Write-Host ('Verified installer: '+$p); & ([scriptblock]::Create([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($b))) } finally { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $p -Force } } }
requirements: Windows x64 and PowerShell 5.1 or newer. The console command supports the default Restricted policy without changing it; it verifies the installer SHA-256 before executing its contents. Group Policy, AllSigned, or constrained language sessions require your administrator-approved installation process. Built and GUI-tested on Windows Server 2025; Windows 11 field validation remains pending.
launch: Open RedAgent from the Start menu.

label: macOS
requirements: Apple Silicon or Intel. The script chooses the native build, including under Rosetta. Built and GUI-tested on macOS 26 (Apple Silicon) and macOS 15 (Intel); older macOS compatibility is not yet established.
launch: Open RedAgent.app inside the installation folder in Finder.

label: Linux
requirements: x86_64 desktop Linux with glibc 2.35+, curl, tar, and X11 libraries. Built and GUI-tested on Ubuntu 22.04. No ARM Linux or musl/Alpine bundle is available.
launch: Run ~/.local/share/RedAgent/RedAgent/RedAgent in a graphical desktop session.
